$meta.name: Travel app design tokens - sprint 3 additions
$meta.status: Approved by Raz with changes (2026-10-26); changes applied. DELTA ONLY: every key below is new; no existing 0.3.0 value changes. Merge into docs/design/tokens.json and apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts in the same PR that first uses them (docs/design/sprint-03/README.md section 15). Keys starting with '$check.' are contrast documentation only and are not merged into tokens.ts.
color.status.note: Trip status tags (README 3.3). planned = the status.info.subtle* values, ended = bg.tag / text.secondary, active keeps status.success.subtle* plus a 6pt dot in status.success.bg and the 3pt status.active.bar. Always a word, never colour only.
globe.final.nextTrip.layers: Own memoised component NextTripPin (owns the pulse timer and drop-in state; pulse state never passes through GlobeLayers props). Source next-trip mounts on the first render with an empty FeatureCollection and aboveLayerID 'small-countries-ring'; with data, one Point at the region label point, properties adm0 + tripId. Layers: next-trip-pulse (CircleLayer, stroke only, pitch alignment + scale 'viewport'), next-trip-pin (SymbolLayer, iconAnchor bottom, allowOverlap + ignorePlacement, pitch + rotation alignment 'viewport', created hidden: iconOpacity 0, iconTranslate [0,-12]), next-trip-hit (CircleLayer radius 32, circleOpacity 0, no stroke, queried before the country hit layers). Far-side fallback: hemisphere test with a threshold measured at HOME_ZOOM and ±0.02 hysteresis, centre from the onCameraChanged payload throttled to 100 ms, subscribed only while a pin exists and the fallback is on; hiding empties the source, so the hit layer hides too; the camera never moves. README 9.2.
globe.final.nextTrip.note: Lagoon 300 like the trip highlight, not Sunset, because Sunset is the selection and a Sunset pin disappears into the selected country's glow (README 9.1). Shown only when signed in and the query succeeded online; kept in memory if the network drops later; removed instantly on sign-out. Moves instantly when the next trip changes.
motion.pin.note: 0.625 Hz, under the 1 Hz limit of AC-7 / WCAG 2.3.1. Driven by Mapbox style transitions, never per frame, and never relying on 'the next frame' (Raz R1): t=0 circleStrokeOpacity 0.7 (duration 0) + circleRadius 20 (duration 1200); t=100 circleStrokeOpacity 0 (duration 1100); t=1200 circleRadius 7 (duration 0) while invisible; the timer repeats every 1600 ms. Pause = circleStrokeOpacity 0 (duration 0) and stop the timer. pulseAllowed = the rotationAllowed conditions in GlobeScreen.tsx, without the 5 s delay, and !E2E. Reduce motion: static pin, no drop-in. Drop-in: required in the static fallback (AC-7); in the pulsing design it is a proposal. It is race-free: the feature and the shown values (iconOpacity 1, iconTranslate [0,0], 400 ms) are set in one update; later moves are instant; sign-out empties the source and resets to hidden with duration 0.
timing.activeTrip.note: AC-8: the next-trip data must arrive within this window after globe-ready, on a cold start, before any user interaction. Once per launch.
limits.city.freeTextMax.note: Decided by Raz: 1–60 code points after trim; DB check char_length 1–60 on trip_cities.name; the build fails if any catalogue name is longer than 60.
limits.text.forbidden: Traveler names and free-text cities reject bidi controls (U+202A–U+202E, U+2066–U+2069) and C0/C1 control characters, in the client and in save_trip.
limits.sprint3.note: Counted in Unicode code points after trim, like limits.note. 'Me' is not stored and not counted in limits.travelers.max; the displayed traveler count includes 'Me' and is shown from 2.
search.cities.note: Offline, per region. normalize(): lowercase, NFD minus combining marks, explicit map for ð þ æ ø ß ł đ ı ħ œ, Hebrew niqqud removed, final letters to regular, all apostrophe/geresh/quote forms removed, dashes and spaces to one space. Match: every query word is a prefix of a word in the Hebrew name, GeoNames name or asciiname. Rank: name starts with the query, then word prefix; population descending inside each group (README 5.3).
format.temp.rounding: half away from zero, once, at display; -0 shows as 0
format.temp.storage: The build stores hundredths of a degree as int16 (2537 = 25.37), never tenths. Display divides by 100 and rounds once.
format.temp.note: Every value is LRI + (U+2212 + digits | digits) + U+00B0 + PDI, never a '+' sign. Range (4+ months): 'בין {{low}} ל-{{high}}' when high >= 0, 'בין {{low}} ובין {{high}}' when high < 0, a single value when low == high. Screen readers get words ('מינוס 3 מעלות'), never the visible string (README 2).
$check.contrast.method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance, (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05), on the hex values in tokens.json 0.3.0. Text needs 4.5:1, graphics 3:1 (1.4.11).
$check.contrast.pin.rule: Body #4FCFBE (L 0.500) passes 3:1 on any background with L <= 0.133; outline #03060F (L 0.0018) passes on any background with L >= 0.106. The ranges overlap, so at least one part passes on every background.
$check.contrast.pin.pulse: Decorative, not required to meet 1.4.11; the pin carries the information.
